Donald Trump is costing American taxpayers billions of dollars for a lethal
long-range missile to illegally bomb Iran, even as he slashes funding for
public services at home.

The Tomahawk - a long-range, precision-strike cruise missile that can carry up
to a 1,000-pound warhead - has already been used in at least one documented
war crime. The _New York
Times_[reported](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/03/08/world/middleeast/iran-
minab-school-strike.html) that videos showed a Tomahawk had struck near the
Minab girls' school in the early hours of the US-Israeli war in Iran. The
footage further proved that the US was responsible for the horrific attack,
since it is the only country in this war with access to Tomahawk missiles.

One Tomahawk takes up to two years to make, and the latest model costs $3.6
million. The US has used over 850 of them in Iran,
[according](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/03/27/iran-
war-tomahawk-missiles/) to the _Washington Post,_ burning through a limited
supply of the costly missile and setting a grim
[record](https://www.stripes.com/theaters/middle_east/2026-03-30/tomahawk-
burn-rate-epic-fury-21225805.html) for the number of times the Tomahawk has
been used in one US conflict alone. The same missiles were also used in
Trump's attacks last year on Iran, Yemen, and Nigeria.
